name: Prime Door (Bare Wood Only)
intent: Apply primer coat to bare wood doors only. Skipped entirely for factory-primed doors. One brush task and one spray task; whichever fires depends on application_method.
doctrine: Spray prime (12 sides/hr) is 2.4x faster than brush prime (5 sides/hr). Both gate by substrate=bare_wood — factory-primed doors skip this entire module via task-level applies_when. The whole module is technically always 'in' the scenario but its tasks SKIP when conditions don't match. This is the same gating pattern that drove the trim state-branching demo, applied to door priming.
